note: RustSimHub Debian base input only; 220 packages resolved from signed snapshot indexes on 2026-10-15. This lock is not a device flash manifest or full-system acceptance.
variant_note: important matches the earlier signed base build; this RustSimHub package combination is not yet booted.

packages.requested_note: tools/rootfs/firmware/debian-packages.json base plus optional dnsmasq-base; helper dependency does not imply hotspot acceptance.

service_user.name: rustsimhub-core
service_user.note: Core fixed numeric identity only; Edge/Media/IPC and first-boot state integration remain separate.

kernel.note: The verified kernel is not built here (firmware/upstream.lock.json names its source). The release engineer supplies the verified boot image and the matching modules archive; --lock records their SHA-256 and every later build checks them, reads the release string out of the kernel itself and refuses modules whose vermagic differs.

image.label: rootfs
image.note: uuid and hash_seed are arbitrary constants so that two builds are identical; the boot command line selects the root filesystem by LABEL or PARTUUID, never by this UUID. size_mib is the size of the stick's rootfs partition: it is not documented in this repository, so it is a required parameter (--image-size-mib, read from the device's partition table).
